description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable Java class 'DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator' that aggregates multiple authentication failure reasons into a single exception, especially in the context of security authentication for the Eclipse Ditto gateway. It provides logic to combine multiple failure reasons, filter specific status codes, and build descriptive messages and headers for failure aggregation.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator
classes.description: Immutable singleton class implementing AuthenticationFailureAggregator, responsible for aggregating multiple authentication failure results into a single exception with descriptive messages and headers.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Aggregates a list of failed authentication results into an exception, filtering based on status codes and creating descriptive headers and messages.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeExceptionReasonsWithDescription
methods.description: Extracts and filters the reasons of failure from authentication results, returning a list of exceptions with descriptions.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Recursively converts a Throwable (or cause chain) into a DittoRuntimeException if possible.

methods.name: buildAggregatedDescriptionFromDittoRuntimeExceptions
methods.description: Creates an aggregated description string from multiple DittoRuntimeExceptions, combining their optional descriptions.

methods.name: buildAggregatedHeaders
methods.description: Builds a combined DittoHeaders object from multiple DittoRuntimeExceptions' headers.
